name: ClassConnect
shortDescription: Low-bandwidth virtual classroom with honest provider integration and async follow-up.
features: Session lifecycle with conflict detection and local-time display
Explicit provider-unavailable state — async workflows keep working, calls never faked
Attendance, moderated chat and question queue, polls
Async follow-up space with assignments and teacher responses
Recording off by default with per-session consent
knownLimitations: No WebRTC credentials ship with the demo; adapter ready for configuration
Provider-dependent connection quality indicators not shown without a provider
